visa-preparation.entry_summary: A visa is needed. The e-Visa is applied for online with SNEDAI, the only site the Côte d'Ivoire state recognises for visa applications: pre-enrol online, pay, then complete biometric enrolment and collect the printed visa at Abidjan airport. A yellow fever certificate is required.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: e-Visa: online pre-enrolment and payment, then the visa is printed on arrival at Abidjan airport after fingerprints and a photo.
visa-preparation.before_departure: Pre-enrol on snedai.com with the passport identity page, a return flight booking and a legalised invitation letter or accommodation certificate (all three are required), pay by Visa or Mastercard, and wait for approval from the Direction de la Surveillance du Territoire.
visa-preparation.useful_stay: The e-Visa is 3 months, multiple entry.

steps.step: Pre-enrol online on SNEDAI and upload the passport identity page, the return flight booking and the invitation letter or accommodation certificate (typed, signed, stamped and legalised).
Pay the visa fee online by Visa or Mastercard and keep the receipt with its payment code.
Wait for the approved pre-enrolment from the Direction de la Surveillance du Territoire (DST); a request isn't a right to the visa.
At Abidjan airport, go to the 'Visa aéroport' desk for fingerprints and a photo; the visa is printed on the spot.
Taking art objects out of the country needs an exit permit from the National Museum.

documents: Legalised invitation letter or accommodation certificate

fees.item: e-Visa, 3 months multiple entry (bank fees included)

open_questions: SNEDAI runs the e-Visa for the state; is the EUR 73 fee also published on a Côte d'Ivoire ministry page?
